social_stories.title: Getting a Haircut
social_stories.content: Today I am getting a haircut. I sit in the big chair. The barber puts a cape around me. The scissors make a snipping sound. The clippers buzz near my ears. This can feel tickly. I can squeeze my fidget toy if it is too much. When the barber finishes, my hair looks neat. I did a great job!

social_stories.title: Going to the Grocery Store
social_stories.content: Today I am going to the grocery store with my parent. The store has bright lights and many people. It can be loud. I can wear my headphones if I need to. I can help by holding the shopping list. We find each item together. When we pay we are almost done. We go to the car and drive home. I was very helpful today!

social_stories.title: Calming Down When Upset
social_stories.content: Sometimes I feel upset. My face gets hot. My heart beats fast. When this happens I can take 3 deep breaths. I breathe in slowly. I breathe out slowly. I count to 10. I can go to my quiet corner. When I feel calm I can use my words to say how I feel. It is okay to feel upset. I can always calm down.

social_stories.title: Making a New Friend
social_stories.content: I see someone I want to be friends with. I can walk up and say Hi my name is. I can ask what their name is. I can ask what they like to play. I listen when they talk. Then I tell them what I like. If they do not want to talk that is okay. I can try again another day. Making friends takes time.

social_stories.title: Eating Lunch at School
social_stories.content: At lunchtime I line up with my class. I get my lunch tray. I find a seat at the table. The cafeteria is noisy. Many children are talking. I will try to eat my lunch. If I feel overwhelmed I can ask my teacher to eat in a quieter place. I eat my food. When I finish I put my tray away. Lunchtime is done.

social_stories.title: Riding the School Bus
social_stories.content: I wait at the bus stop with my parent. The bus comes. I get in line. I say hello to the bus driver. I sit in my seat and put on my seatbelt. The bus can be noisy. I can look out the window or use my headphones. When we arrive at school the bus stops. I wait for my row to stand up. I say goodbye to the driver. I did it!

social_stories.title: Going to the Doctor
social_stories.content: Today I am going to see the doctor. We sit in the waiting room. When it is my turn we go to the exam room. The doctor wants to check that I am healthy. The doctor will look in my ears and my mouth. They may press on my tummy. This is to help me feel well. I can tell the doctor if something hurts. When we are done we go home. I was very brave today!

social_stories.title: Taking Turns on the Swing
social_stories.content: At the playground there is one swing. Many children want to use it. I need to wait for my turn. I can count to 30 while someone else swings. Then it is my turn. Waiting is hard but I can do it. When I am on the swing I count to 30 too. Then it is someone else's turn. Taking turns makes everyone happy.

social_stories.title: Attending a Birthday Party
social_stories.content: Today I am going to a birthday party. There will be music and many people. It might be very loud. I can ask for a break in a quiet spot if I need one. There will be cake and balloons. When everyone sings Happy Birthday I can cover my ears if it is too loud. I can stay close to my parent. Parties can be fun even if they are loud.

social_stories.title: Handling a Change in Routine
social_stories.content: Sometimes things change. Today we are not following our usual plan. A change can feel uncomfortable. That feeling is okay. I can take a deep breath. I can ask my parent what will happen instead. Changes do not last forever. After the change things will be normal again. I can handle changes. I am flexible and strong.
